scenario.title: Field-notes, curation and session continuity
situations: An agent encounters a recipe gap or supporting observation.
An operator wants to turn repeated failures into work.
A long session must hand off its current state.
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Does a projectless session have a valid supported field-note ownership/recovery path after P1?
Has the note-to-full-evidence link been checked on installed/workbench surfaces?

lessons.title: Record evidence where it can be found again
lessons.when: At an actual recipe gap, failed recipe or supporting observation
lessons.need: Use a field-note with bounded evidence and the correct kind; read its help decision tree. A note is a supporting learning record, not automatically an executable work item.
lessons.surface: Generated AGENTS/skill directive -> field-note append help; public Ouroboros page.

lessons.title: Curate deliberately rather than auto-file everything
lessons.when: Repeated notes or observations suggest a system problem
lessons.need: Curate clusters unreviewed evidence, verifies the current cause, chooses the work shape and archives handled entries. It is operator-invoked, not an automatic background policy.
lessons.surface: Help/native skill catalog -> Curate; public Ouroboros section -> /yoke curate.

lessons.title: Keep continuity separate from chat memory
lessons.when: Wrapping up, resuming or recovering after compaction
lessons.need: Use item Progress Log as a current-state checkpoint with evidence links; re-read the current phase and durable artifacts. Wrapup records observations/unfinished work. A UI preference or old transcript is not authoritative work state.
lessons.surface: Wrapup router -> survey/record phases; AGENTS compaction instruction; public learning page.
